power.neoorigins.feline_mobs_ignore.desc: E wehi ana nga kai-whakamiri i a koe, a e kore e whakatata atu.

power.neoorigins.feline_hunger_drain.des: Ka tahuna te pūngao 30% tere atu i te tangata.
origins.neoorigins.golem.name: Ko te Kohatu
origins.neoorigins.golem.description: He kaha haere o te rino me te hiahia tata-kore, engari puhoi me te ngoikore ki te wera.
power.neoorigins.golem_natural_armor.des: Te ātete pūmau I te whakarewa whakarewa e whakaweto ana i nga whiu ahakoa kaore i te taputapu.
E 80% te ātete ki te whakaheke.
power.neoorigins.golem_size.name: Te anga o te papa
power.neoorigins.golem_size.description: He 30% nui ake i te kaitākaro noa.
power.neoorigins.golem_effect_immunity.d: E ārai ana ki te mōrea, te mate, me te hiakai.
power.neoorigins.golem_slow_movement.des: He 25% te tere ake i te tangata noa.
power.neoorigins.golem_fire_weakness.des: E tangohia ana e 80% atu kino i te ahi, lava, me magma kōpaki whakapā rino kawe wera.
origins.neoorigins.caveborn.name: Ko te Caveborn
origins.neoorigins.caveborn.description: I whakatipuhia i te pōuri hohonu kai ana i te kohatu matomato, e ngaki ana i roto i te ore me ona ringa noa, engari ka mate i te mahana o te ra.
power.neoorigins.caveborn_night_vision.n: Te Whakapā Mai i te Roto
power.neoorigins.caveborn_night_vision.d: Ko nga kanohi e whakatikatika ana ki te pōuri hohonu kaore he rama e hiahiatia ana. Whakamahia te paatene Night Vision (K taunoa).
power.neoorigins.caveborn_no_fall_damage: Ko te Whakatika i te ana
E mohio ana ki te whakatere i runga i te oneone kore.
power.neoorigins.caveborn_mining_speed.d: Ka pakaru i ngā kōpaki katoa i te wā e rua i te tere o te kōpaki ka tukua te kohatu ki ngā ringa mōhio.
power.neoorigins.caveborn_stone_fists.de: Ko nga ringa noa e hanga ana e ahau, he rite ki te parauri kohatu. Ka pakaru nga kohatu me nga kohatu kaore he taputapu.
power.neoorigins.caveborn_mining_fortune: I te wa e kaha ana te Luck (e homai ana e te kai taimana), ka heke nga kōpaki kohatu me te mea kua kerihia me te Fortune II.
power.neoorigins.caveborn_eat_stone.name: Ko te Kaihatu Kohatu
power.neoorigins.caveborn_eat_stone.desc: Ka taea te kai i te kohatu, te kohatu, te kohatu, te diorite, te andesite, te tuff, te deepslate, te deepslate, te basalt, me te kohatu pango mo te kai iti.
power.neoorigins.nether_fungus_diet.name: Ko te kai a te fungus
power.neoorigins.nether_fungus_diet.desc: He kai tika nga waikura me nga waikura whero i roto i te Nether pāwhiri matau ki te kai mo te hiakai 5 me te 0.6 te makona.
power.neoorigins.caveborn_eat_copper.des: Ka taea te kai i te parahi parahi, parahi raw, parahi parahi, parahi parahi hohonu, me te parahi parahi raw he kai ohie i waenganui i te kohatu me te rino. e kore e haere ki raro i te manawanui tonu.
power.neoorigins.caveborn_eat_iron.name: Ko te papanga rino
power.neoorigins.caveborn_eat_iron.descr: Ka taea te kai i te rino, te rino raw, te rino nuggets, te rino ore, te hohonu o te rino ore, me te rino raw blocks te kai tika mo te minita. e kore e haere ki raro ki te ki tonu o te kopu.
power.neoorigins.caveborn_eat_gold.name: Ko te papahiko o te papahiko
power.neoorigins.caveborn_eat_gold.descr: Ka taea te kai i ngā kōpaki koura, koura matomato, kōpaki koura, kōpaki koura, kōpaki koura, kōpaki koura matomato, kōpaki koura matomato.
power.neoorigins.caveborn_eat_diamond.de: Ka taea e ia te kai i te taimana, te kohatu taimana, me te kohatu taimana hohonu e ōrite ana ki te karaiti koura i te whakaranu.
power.neoorigins.caveborn_eat_emerald.de: Ka taea te kai i te maramara, te maramara ore, me te maramara ore hohonu te kai tino taonga i tua atu i te netherite. E kore e haere ki raro i te manawa ki tonu.
Ka taea e ia te kai i nga ngutu, i nga takawaenga, i nga otaota tawhito, te kai tino nui o te ao.
power.neoorigins.caveborn_copper_bonus.d: Ko te kai i te parahi e tuku ana i te wai i te manawa i te 60 hēkona.
power.neoorigins.caveborn_iron_bonus.nam: Ko te Rūhi o te Uira
power.neoorigins.caveborn_iron_bonus.des: Ko te kai i te rino e tuku ana i ahau kia hohoro ahau mo te 60 hēkona.
power.neoorigins.caveborn_gold_bonus.des: Ko te kai i ngā pūtea koura Speed I mō te rua meneti.
Ko te Maama o te Taimana
Ko te kai i te taimana e whakawhiwhia ana ki a Luck II mo te 5 meneti ka taea e te Mining Fortune i te wa e mahi ana.
Ko te kai i te emerald e whakarato ana i te Whakaaetanga ahi mo te 5 meneti ka wera tonu koe i te ra, engari kaore e taea e ia te tahuna atu.
power.neoorigins.caveborn_netherite_bonu: Ko te kai i te netherite e whakarato ana i te kaha I me te ātete I mo te 5 meneti.
power.neoorigins.caveborn_daylight_damag: Ka pupuhi te ahi, ka pakaru i te 1 kino ia hēkona ka tukuna ki te mahana o te ra.
power.neoorigins.caveborn_small_frame.de: 85% te rahi o te kaitākaro noa tunnels pakari e ngāwari.
origins.neoorigins.sylvan.name: Ko Sylvan
origins.neoorigins.sylvan.description: He wairua o te ngahere tawhito tere i waenga i nga rakau, e arohaina ana e nga kararehe mohoao, e kaha ana ki te whakakotahi i nga hoariri me te piki o nga pakiaka.
power.neoorigins.sylvan_mobs_ignore.name: Kotahi ki te Rorohiko
power.neoorigins.sylvan_mobs_ignore.desc: Ka mahue koe e ngā hui hoariri, ka utua e rātou mēnā ka patua koe i te tuatahi.
power.neoorigins.sylvan_regen_in_water.n: Ko te Whiwhi o te Huarere
power.neoorigins.sylvan_regen_in_water.d: Ka ora āta i te wā e pā ana ki te wai.
power.neoorigins.sylvan_forest_speed.des: Ka piki ake te tere i a ia e noho ana i roto i nga koiora ngahere.
power.neoorigins.sylvan_nether_damage.de: Ka tango i te 1 kino i ia hēkona i roto i te Nether biomes.
origins.neoorigins.draconic.name: Ko te Draconic
origins.neoorigins.draconic.description: He toto tarakona, he wehi hoki, he ngoikore ki te ahi, he whakamataku hoki ki nga kararehe, engari ko te mura draconic e tahu ana i te kaha tere.
He ārai ki te ahi, ko te rākau, ko te magma, me te wera o te toto tarakona.
E rere ana i roto i te hauhau rite ki te hunga e rere ana i roto i te wai.
power.neoorigins.draconic_lava_vision.de: Ka kite mārama i roto i te rākau, kahore he pōuri me te pōuri ahi te hohonu whakarewa huna kahore.

Ka pupuhi te ahi, e rua nga kino i ia hēkona, ina whakauruhia ki te mahana o te ra.
